messages:
Ola (Customer Success): Quick heads-up 1: invoice 5588 for Sable Therapeutics failed in our morning sweep. Stripe decline `do_not_honor`. They're on a go-live call and asking for same-day options (wire or manual ACH). Can we assist? :sweat:

billing-bot: [payment.failed] invoice=5588 customer=SableTherapeutics provider=Stripe code=do_not_honor id=pi_9Qw... log="card_decline_do_not_honor"

Maya (Finance): We can do one manual retry but gateway rules say wait ~10m. Recommend offering Fedwire for same-day clearing or Plaid ACH if they can. If their bank blocks micro-deposits (often with business savings/lockbox accounts), accept: 1) outbound bank confirmation (SWIFT/pdf), 2) bank letter on letterhead, or 3) signed ACH authorization + a bank-stamped screenshot.

Sam (Ops): Ops note: avoid back-to-back auths within 5m. If you want me to queue a manual retry, I'll do +15m. Also, if you plan to accept a wire confirmation as "paid pending", we should create a QuickBooks manual payment entry to suppress dunning.

Ethan (Sales): Hold provisioning until payment or wire proof. If they wire today, we can waive the one-time expedited fee and spin infra immediately. Tell them that to help expedite. :pray:

Ola (Customer Success): Billing contact is payments@sabletx.com. They tried a corporate virtual card and it declined. AP prefers Fedwire for amounts >$10k. Sending them options now.

Maya (Finance): Wire instructions (secure channel only) - paste into encrypted email or our secure portal:

```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank (Fedwire): First National Bank of Redwood
Fedwire Routing: 026009593
Account #: 987654321
SWIFT/BIC: FNBUS33
Reference: INVOICE 5588 / Sable Therapeutics
```

Maya (Finance): Request they include payer legal name and invoice number in the reference. When they forward the outbound confirmation (PDF/SWIFT copy with timestamp & sender), finance will record a "paid pending settlement" entry in QuickBooks and lift holds.

Ola (Customer Success): Sent the Fedwire template to payments@sabletx.com via secure mail. They replied "wiring now, will forward confirmation" and asked if a bank-stamped emailed receipt is OK.

Maya (Finance): Bank-stamped emailed receipts are acceptable if they show routing, account, timestamp and payer name. If anything's ambiguous, ask for the SWIFT copy. I'll add an AR note to suppress automated reminders for invoice 5588 once confirmation is posted.

Sam (Ops): Standby to provision once Maya marks invoice as paid pending. If you post the confirmation here I can unblock infra within 30m.

Ethan (Sales): Thanks team. Ola, paste the redacted confirmation here when they send it and tag Ops/Finance. I'll prep the provisioning ticket. :white_check_mark:
